title: 2BR Condo in Seacrest Beach, FL with Beach & Pool Access
meta_description: High Pointe 32W, a Gulf Front 2BR, 2BA condo in Seacrest Beach, with a sofa bed, beach access, 2 free beach bikes, Gulf views, and a shared pool. Sleeps 8.
description_expanded: DescriptionWhat Guests Love• 2 Complimentary Seasonal Beach Chair Set Up (March 1st - October 31st)• 2 Complimentary Adult Beach Cruiser Bicycles• Crystal clear views of the Gulf from the beachfront balcony• Gulf Views from the Living Room and Master Bedroom• Seconds from the beach, community’s resort-style pool, and Crabby Steve’s Restaurant and Bar• 1315 square feet• High speed WIFI internet• Sonos Sound System• Delicately tucked away between Rosemary and Alys Beach• Located in the gated community of High PointeThis newly renovated and decorated home is luxuriously spacious and elegant. HighPointe 32W is located on the 3rd floor of the West Building of the High Pointe community. View of the Gulf greets you from the moment you walk through the door. Wake up to the ocean breeze and gently drift off to sleep to the soothing sounds of crashing waves right outside your door.CONDO LAYOUT (Sleeps 8)• Renovated Kitchen with new upgraded stainless-steel appliances• Breakfast bar with seating for 4 • Dining room table with seating for 6• Sleeper Sofa in Living Room• Master Bedroom: King Bed Facing the Gulf, Private Bathroom with Large Walk-In Shower • Guest Room: Two Queen Beds, Shared BathroomHIGH POINTE COMMUNITY HIGHLIGHTS• Shuffleboard Courts• Tennis Courts and Tennis Pro Available for Lessons (additional cost)• Children’s Playground• Lagoon Style Pool and Hot Tub• Seasonal Kids’ CampTDT-208060
